description.en:
Walker X is UBTECH's commercial-service humanoid combining bipedal movement, spoken interaction and object manipulation. The manufacturer lists a height of 130 cm, a mass of 63 kg and 41 servo joints, with a curved-screen facial interface and removable battery.

Its capabilities bring together U-SLAM navigation, path planning, visual perception and hand-eye coordination. Whole-body control supports balance and responses to disturbances, while articulated arms and hands allow interaction with objects. Walker X is positioned for intelligent service demonstrations and application development across human-oriented settings. The supported tasks and autonomous behavior depend on the software and site configuration.
